title: Well-Balanced Subcell Limiting for Discontinuous Galerkin Discretizations of the Shallow-Water Equations
summary: High-order discontinuous Galerkin (DG) methods equipped with subcell finite-volume (FV) limiters provide an efficient framework for the simulation of nonlinear hyperbolic balance laws featuring shocks and complex flow structures. However, for systems with non-conservative terms, the design of hybrid DG/FV schemes that simultaneously guarantee high-order accuracy, robustness, and well-balancedness remains challenging.
